name: The Count's Portraitist
summary: Tudor, who paints the Baron's wicker sun, was fetched to the castle and kept eleven nights painting a woman from the count's memory. He can't stop painting her.

stages.journal: A driverless carriage took Tudor the painter to the castle for eleven nights to paint a woman in white from the count's memory, with the count's own paints. Now every face he paints is hers, and he has sold three: to the Baron, to Lady Wachter, and to Urwin at the inn.
objectives: Go into Tudor's studio on the east row
Deal with the great canvas the count gave him to copy from

stages.journal: The count spoke to us out of the painted woman's mouth. Then the canvas and its copies came off the walls, and we burned it.
objectives: Speak to Tudor at his door in the evening

stages.journal: Every copy in Vallaki went blank when the great canvas burned, the Baron's included. Tudor scraped the count's paints into clean pots and said a prayer over them, and gave them to us.
